ns2:course.label: Statistical Thermodynamics
ns2:course.description: Fundamentals of thermodynamics and statistical mechanics, covering equilibria, thermodynamic transforms, phase transitions, ensembles and non-equilibrium statistical mechanics, from single molecules to complex biological systems. Prerequisite: CHEM 442 and CHEM 444, or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: CHEM 442 and CHEM 444, or equivalent.
